tabs.label: Soundboard
tabs.intro:
A soundboard of AI voice clips imitating the hosts of [Very Bad Wizards](https://verybadwizards.com), made with voice conversion models trained on the podcast.

- **DaveBot** imitates Dave Pizarro.
- **TamBot** imitates Tamler Sommers.
